entities.summary: Be-Ge Hockey Center, formerly Arena Oskarshamn, is the home ice of Swedish ice-hockey team IK Oskarshamn, located in the south-east of Sweden. The arena was completely rebuilt and renovated in 2004-2005 and has a capacity of 3,275 people (2018/2019).
